shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated angular/zigzag pattern encircling or crossing the surface
justification: The only correspondence is a horizontal band of repeated angular (chevron/zigzag or triangular) motifs running around the upper part of A's vessel and appearing as a banded register in B, which is a near-universal decorative device. B otherwise carries a dense figural programme in registers (a crouching quadruped in profile, a bird with outstretched neck, arms and hands, a mask-like row of arches at the top) while A shows no figural imagery whatsoever.
